text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One early afternoon, I stopped by the cafeteria and found Kawakami Princess, Hishi Akebono, and Mayano Top Gun together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Welcome to Bono's Cooking Class☆ Today we're making carrot cake~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: First, let's cut up the carrots. Make them small enough to fit in the blender♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Understood. Now then, where is the kitchen knife...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh~? Can't find it. Maybe it's being washed right now?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It seems so. What a waste of time to simply wait. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: We do it like this—DEEEEEEIYAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRACK-SNAP-CRUNCH-SNAP!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~!? Th-That's amazing, Kawakami-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: They turned out just the right size too! That's bono☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Alright, the batter is ready. Now let's pour it into the mold~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Bono-sensei, Maya wants a heart shape, pleeease♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Roger☆ Heart shape it is! Let's see, where is the mold—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Hmm, looks like it's dented.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You're right... Oh no, it won't make a pretty heart shape like this~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, fear not. We simply need to pop the dented part back into shape.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Take this, like so—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —and DEYAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLAAANGGG!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it really went back to normal! That surprised me, but totally bono☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Alright, all that's left is baking! Let's preheat the oven♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Set the temperature, and... Huh? The oven won't turn on. Is it broken?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No way, and we came all this way too~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fufu, worry not. Maruzen-san once told me that when a machine breaks down, hitting it will fix it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~~! But that's...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That might be a bit dangerous...! Wait, Kawakami-cha—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Here I go—CHESTOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRRRRAAAAAASSSHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaah~~!! Watch ouuut!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess's strike split the oven clean in half, sending other cookware scattering across the floor from the impact...!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: Hey!! What do you think you're doing?! That's dangerous!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eeek...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Kawakami-chan! Maya-chan and I finished baking it~! Let's eat together☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I am so sorry... Getting banned from the kitchen prevented me from finishing it alongside you...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A true princess must not rely solely on brute force... I shall reflect deeply on this.
